name: Syncwright
tagline: Keep a whole bot roster in Notion and rebuild it on another account
description: Treat one Notion database as the master record for every bot you run: routines, channels and standing rules. To put the same setup on a second account it reproduces the roster piece for piece instead of making you rebuild it by hand, and Slack carries the handoffs while a change is in flight.
author: scottslabio
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
